name: maison-ndamen-peintre-prof
description: Maison Ndamen — Peintre Professionnel & Maître Artisan Staffeur d'Exception au Cameroun (Douala, Yaoundé, Kribi, Limbe).

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist', {recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync('index.html', 'dist/index.html'); if(fs.existsSync('images')) fs.cpSync('images', 'dist/images', {recursive:true}); if(fs.existsSync('public')) fs.cpSync('public', 'dist', {recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync('index.html', 'dist/index.html'); console.log('Static site built into dist successfully');"

author: Jean-Paul Ndamen & Maison Ndamen
